status: Locked before full-cohort model evaluation; informed by earlier 96-person pilot, not preregistered
dataset: ABIDE I PCP C-PAC filt_noglobal rois_ho
eligibility: DX_GROUP 1 or 2; valid FILE_ID; finite mean FD between 0 and 0.30 mm inclusive; no fail in qc_rater_1, qc_anat_rater_2, qc_func_rater_2, qc_anat_rater_3, qc_func_rater_3; finite ROI time series with 111 consistent labels and >=70 frames. Maybe/missing ratings retained and reported. Invalid age/sex set missing, train-only median imputation.
centers: SITE_ID with UM_1/UM_2, UCLA_1/UCLA_2, LEUVEN_1/LEUVEN_2 merged by institution; all other IDs unchanged
outer_cv: LeaveOneGroupOut by institution-level center; every participant held out exactly once
inner_cv: GroupKFold(3) by institution-level center restricted to each outer training set; mean fold ROC-AUC hyperparameter objective
preprocessing: Train-only median imputation, zero for entirely absent train columns; StandardScaler; fixed randomized PCA(32, seed 2026) on connectome then rescale. Separate demo imputation/scaling. No fitted whole-cohort harmonization. No test-driven threshold or feature selection.
primary_endpoint: Equal-center mean ROC-AUC of held-out predictions; combined minus demographic paired difference for LR, SVM, RF
secondary: Equal-center and pooled balanced accuracy, ASD F1, sensitivity, specificity; pooled AUC descriptive due cross-fold score scaling; per-center confusion matrices
uncertainty: 10000 paired center bootstrap resamples for macro metrics and differences, conditional on fitted predictions; per-center stratified participant bootstrap 2000; uncertainty excludes retraining variation
inference: Exact paired site-level sign-flip test for primary AUC differences when <=20 centers, Holm across the 3 primary models. Secondary pairwise comparisons exploratory, Holm within family. No case-level DeLong test treating overlapping CV fits as independent.

sensitivities.complete_case: Drop participants with any missing connectome edge, rerun all 9 conditions
sensitivities.drop_roi3455: Remove pilot-identified constant ROI #3455 edges a priori, keep all primary participants; rerun all 9 conditions
sensitivities.low_motion: Primary participants mean FD<=0.20 mm; rerun LR 3 feature groups
sensitivities.pca8: Primary participants; fixed 8 components; rerun LR 3 feature groups
sensitivities.strict_manual: Primary participants all 5 manual ratings OK; rerun LR 3 feature groups

confounding_checks: Site/class age, sex, FD, QC/missingness summaries; age sex FD effects on missingness adjusted for center with binomial GLM; train-only age/sex/FD linear residualization of edges as additional LR connectome sensitivity; no causal interpretation
limitations: Secondary analysis; pilot-informed fixed choices; no independent ABIDE II validation, no clinical utility claim, no test-driven result optimization. No full-pipeline permutation significance claimed. Ethics status, authorship, funding and AI disclosure require author review before submission.
